title: A US statistics professor just won a fellowship to spend his summers teaching at IIT Bombay
sources: NC State University (Department of Statistics) - Sujit Ghosh awarded VAIBHAV Fellowship
Indian Statistical Institute - Sujit Ghosh awarded VAIBHAV Fellowship
caption:
A US statistics professor just won a fellowship to spend his summers teaching at IIT Bombay. Chosen from 217 applicants worldwide.

Sujit Ghosh, a Professor of Statistics at North Carolina State University and an Indian Statistical Institute alumnus, was awarded India's VAIBHAV Fellowship. Over the next three years, he'll spend one to two months a year at IIT Bombay working on statistics, biostatistics and climate science. He's already helped set up a formal partnership between NC State and IIT Bombay.

Most sabbaticals are a one-time trip. This one is a three-year standing invitation to keep coming back.

Sources: NC State University, Indian Statistical Institute
